notes.title: Bonbon Update/Patch 2.2 Is Live
notes.content:
We've been listening to feedback and bug reports since launch day and have deployed a new version of Bonbon - 2.2.  Here is what's new:

[list]
[*] Added a windowed mode, in the Options menu.
[*] Added a brightness setting, in the Options menu.
[*] Added a option to switch to a simpler fur shader. This should help with the frame rate drop some players experience when Bonbon appears.
[*] Made some adjustments to help with a rare bug that could cause some systems to stick on the initial loading screen.
[*] Fixed achievement exploit - you can no longer get "Little Chatterbox" by repeatedly talking to Bonbon.
[*] Simplified some toy collision meshes. This should give a performance boost on certain systems.
[*] Exposed a cheat to let you skip to a specific scene from the start menu, in case of problems or if you want to replay from a certain scene. On the title screen press:
--- [shift] + [1] for the garden scene
--- [shift] + [2] for the lounge scene
--- [shift] + [3] for the dinner table scene
--- [shift] + [4] for the bedtime story
--- [shift] + [5] for the dream sequence
--- [shift] + [6] for the waking up scene
--- [shift] + [7] for the end credits
[/list]

We hope this helps... let us know if you have any new issues in the forums.  Thanks!

-Miles @ Pixeljam
